851-5742-5743-8242.description:
Activate Songbird by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Songbird ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

907-1432-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
907-1432-2645-3430.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1833-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
1833-3899-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1495-2060-5544-6431-8095.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-5544-6431-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4053-5499-7730--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5499-7730--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

3480-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

457-1409-7155-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Fiend by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Fiend leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Fiend
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Fiend when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Fiend and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-7155-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

2292-6972-7511.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2292-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1687-2034-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

3259-4068-7208.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-4681-5170-6559.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4050-4311-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4050-4311-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1245-4871-6291.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token.
Repeat.

2634-4973-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
2634-4973-5259.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the Rude Awakening copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

2018-3826-3967.easyPrerequisites: Medicine Runner does not have a flying counter on it.
2018-3826-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Medicine Runner.
When Medicine Runner dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Medicine Runner from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Medicine Runner enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Medicine Runner.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

413-803-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
413-803-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

301-997-5643.notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-997-5643.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1061-4899.description:
During your upkeep step, activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Resolve all Phyrexian Devourer abilities, eventually causing you to sacrifice it.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your draw step, drawing Timestream Navigator from your library.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Move to your next turn.
During your upkeep step, activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

80-2784-3019-3152-3992.notablePrerequisites:
Cyclical Evolution in exile with three time counters on it.
Venture Forth in exile with two time counters on it.
Inspiring Refrain in exile with one time counter on it.Alaundo the Seer does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
80-2784-3019-3152-3992.description:
Activate Alaundo the Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and exile a card from your hand with time counters on it equal to its mana value, then removing a time counter from each other card you own in exile.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Alaundo the Seer.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards, then exiling Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Activate Alaundo the Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and exile a card from your hand with time counters on it equal to its mana value, then removing a time counter from each other card you own in exile.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Alaundo the Seer.
Resolve Venture Forth, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a land card, then putting the land card onto the battlefield and the rest of the cards exiled this way on the bottom of your library, and then exiling Venture Forth with three time counters on it.
Activate Alaundo the Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and exile a card from your hand with time counters on it equal to its mana value, then removing a time counter from each card you own in exile.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Alaundo the Seer.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution, giving target creature +3/+3 until end of turn and then exiling Cyclical Evolution with three time counters on it.
Repeat.

692-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
692-3490-4050.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Wildwood Mentor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

301-317-2292.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
301-317-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
Putrid Goblin dies, triggering its persist ability and Mazirek.
Resolve the Putrid Goblin trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
